name: Pallvault
summary: Paired burst-emitter arms close behind full assault plate. A central plasma rifle pressures enemy reactors while compound cooling supports repeated salvos.
lore: A Pallvault carries its command enclosure below a broad armoured crown. Restoration crews reduced the engine package slightly to restore full assault plate and a central plasma rifle alongside the paired burst-emitter arms. Compound exchangers support the resulting battery without ammunition bins. It remains unusually mobile for its weight, but the procession still needs room to turn. The Continuance calls the armour ceremonial. The crews who return with it missing know what it costs.
strengths: Heavy armour and accurate burst batteries
Central plasma remains after an arm is lost
weaknesses: Full battery works best at medium and close range
